bullets.text: Motorway 5G Upgrades - **VMO2** enhances 4G and 5G coverage across 600 miles of UK motorways, supporting electric vehicle rollout.
Protecting Undersea Networks - UK commits to safeguarding critical undersea infrastructure amid rising threats from **Russia** and **China**.
AI Agents as Customers - The telecom industry must adapt to AI agents managing connectivity choices, shifting from B2C to B2Ai.
MSSA NTN Integration - The **Mobile Satellite Services Association** recommends fast-tracking non-terrestrial network integration for improved connectivity.
World Communication Awards 2025 - The shortlist for the **World Communication Awards** highlights innovators in the telecom industry.
AI Transformation Urgency - Telecoms face extinction without embracing AI transformation, according to industry experts.
Fibre Competition in the UK - The UK must secure long-term competition in digital infrastructure to avoid a return to dominance by a single entity.
Google's TalayLink Cable - **Google** unveils a new subsea cable to enhance connectivity between **Australia** and **Thailand**.
Nokia's $4 Billion Investment - **Nokia** plans to invest $4 billion in US AI-ready network technologies to enhance connectivity.
Verizon Job Cuts - **Verizon** plans to cut 15,000 jobs as part of a strategy to streamline operations.
